gen-dafont-zag-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of sans text, its letters held open rather than curled shut. Zag, with its tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, makes a punchy top line, so a size bump on the heading would suit it.
gen-dafont-zag-manrope:
Manrope reads bright and approachable, with open curves and a minimal step up to capitals.

Zag is best at bold, tightly tracked statements that stay crisp when shrunk, while Manrope does its best work in smooth, single-width lines that never feel crowded.
gen-dafont-zag-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall, its x-height soaring and every stroke cut to one width, so words feel friendly and unfussy. Satoshi's wide-open e never looks squeezed, which gives Zag's tight, commanding headings a roomy partner.
gen-dafont-znikomit-fs-gambetta:
Znikomit rounds its curves with wide-set endings.

Gambetta follows in a classic serif, its stroke weight shifting noticeably but gently, with wide channels into each counter, so paragraphs feel bookish and graceful as the eye moves along.
gen-dafont-znikomit-fs-karma: Quiet and spare, Znikomit lets its wide-set curve ends do the talking up top. Karma, a serif with terminals that finish well clear of the stem, brings a classic, trustworthy tone with modulation that never snags the eye.
gen-dafont-znikomit-fs-merriweather-sans:
Merriweather Sans looks sturdy, its tall lowercase making each word seem large.

Znikomit stays minimal above it, with moderate lowercase height, so a long page feels like it settles into a steady, clear rhythm with the e opening wide to the right.
gen-dafont-znikomit-fs-neco: Znikomit is a minimal sans whose round forms end in wide-set curves, light and quiet at the top. Neco's text serif swells from hairline to stem and never pinches shut, so it reads with dignity.
gen-dafont-znikomit-lora: Lora reads literary and bookish, its modest hairlines thinning at the curves and its c opening broadly. Lora sits comfortably beneath Znikomit, where a minimal sans with wide-set curve ends hands the page to a text serif with softer hairlines.
